notes.maxLengthBasis: Every maxLength is derived from the narrowest supported viewport (360px). The .container reserves 24px of padding each side, leaving 312px, and each component subtracts its own padding on top of that. Characters per line = available width / (0.5 x rendered font size), which is the mean advance of Satoshi and Clash Display for mixed-case copy. maxLength is then that figure multiplied by the number of lines the component can grow to before it pushes the layout out of shape. Where a limit looks generous it is because the live copy already uses that many lines.
